subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should channels without native media group metadata, especially LINE, get an opt-in same-sender media batching buffer in the LINE plugin, a shared channel SDK contract, or no batching support?
rationale: The remaining work changes webhook latency and adds configuration for a channel without reliable grouping metadata, so automation should not choose the default, heuristic, or owner boundary alone.

options.title: LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch downloadable media by account, conversation, and sender with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

options.title: Shared channel contract
options.body: Design a media-aware channel SDK/core contract first, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review before changing LINE.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Keep native Telegram album handling only and document that channels without grouping metadata dispatch media events individually.

recommendation.title: LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch downloadable media by account, conversation, and sender with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner to the LINE handler/config path and cross-channel policy surface where the product boundary needs to be chosen.
